topic: External Parts and Functions of Animals
key_concepts: Different animals have different body parts.
Each body part has a specific function.
Eyes help animals see their way as they move.
Ears are used for hearing sounds.
The nose is used for smelling.
Legs are used for walking, running, and jumping.
Horns and hooves are used to fight enemies.
Backbone, ribs, and legs give support and form to an animal's body.
Paws are used to scratch enemies.
Cat whiskers help a cat feel its way around.
Fur or feathers protect animals from heat and cold.
Tails are used to send away insects.
